rationale:
Independent review of the Phase1 analysis-only proposal (ANALYSIS-SPEC-1, directions beyond Sprint13B). I read the review config, the full proposed spec text (supplied verbatim in STATE), the accepted stock-take S (26abd688...), the operator-run Sprint13A aggregate view A (e5cb1b3e...) and its omission manifest (5a52ab34...), the 13B scope B (a74959ac...), the completed item2 proposal P (9ef81106...), the 2026-10-06 Modal costing C (3a4ab141...), the public price evidence (0175d1c5...), and item2-evidence-limitations (97f0dce4...).

Numeric verification against originals. Direction 1: fusion vs reported nnU-Net +0.028 (97.5% +0.015,+0.042) = A paired.csv P2 line (95%: +0.016 to +0.041; 97.5%: +0.015 to +0.042); vs self-volume nnU-Net +0.025 (95% +0.014,+0.038); vs tree +0.020 (+0.007,+0.033); fusion-vs-tree lesion F1 -0.058 (-0.088,-0.031); complementarity Spearman 0.81 and found-by-neither 0.671 for tree vs nnU-Net+CTA. The proposal correctly distinguishes the Bonferroni 97.5% primary interval from exploratory 95% intervals and flags that P2 is a total (combination+rule+resampling) change, which motivates the proposed volume-matched placement test. Direction 2: recall +0.067, lesion F1 -0.030 (-0.048,-0.015) for P2; full-tree-rule on nnU-Net lesion F1 +0.054 (+0.030,+0.081) with Dice +0.006; bin counts 28/50/20 plus one empty truth (S); IoU>=0.2 matching (A provenance). Direction 3: tree Dice 0.208->0.121 at 0.5 with five empty predictions (A methods.csv). Direction 4: Sprint12b +0.008 (printed +0.000,+0.015), centre counts 67/31/1 (S). Direction 5 is a zero-compute desk audit. All transcriptions agree with the inspected originals.

Cost arithmetic verified against C recorded Sandbox rates ($0.1419/core-h, $0.024/GiB-h): T=4c/16GiB=$0.9516/h, M=8c/32GiB=$1.9032/h; per-test ranges and 30% contingency and the Tests1+2 totals ($9.52-26.65 base, $12.37-34.64 contingency) all reconcile. GPU cost zero is correct for post-hoc saved-prediction/CPU work.

Scope and governance. The proposal is consistently analysis-only: no patient access, probe code, notebooks, training, GPU/Modal jobs or additional model calls; eligible-99 only with final25/reserve24 untouched (consistent with recorded reserved membership 49 and ISLES-SPRINT-LOCK-01); privacy/leakage decisions explicitly held for the operator (Direction 5); no novelty, causal, clinical-use or untouched-test claim. It preserves scientific disagreement (per-direction for/against, the author counterargument that shared missed signal may cap postprocessing returns, and an explicit invitation for the reviewer to challenge the ranking), distinguishes observed saved values from inference, and discloses the exposed cohort, dependent OOF-tuned fits, and the missing executed r4 source. It uses the current-task authority framing (item5 sixteen calls under 38b3f72...) and assumes no remaining allowance. The prior item2 document attributes the same 16-call figure to "item2" rather than "item5," but that is a historical-record wording difference the proposal correctly supersedes with current task authority; it is not a defect in this proposal and raises no budget issue because this stage carries no execution authority.

Current finding status and target decisions are both empty; the proposal correctly records the finding index as [] and treats S/P judgments as attributed history rather than current blockers or proof of execution. No carried-forward findings exist. I found no code/spec mismatch, no metric/statistic error, no leakage, privacy, budget, or execution-authority/provenance defect requiring correction. Completing this review did not require scope beyond item5. APPROVE with findings=[].
